name: Audio recorder
description: Record from the microphone into the note you're writing: the recording is saved as an attachment, embedded at the cursor and transcribed under it on this machine (Apple's on-device speech recognition on macOS 26, nothing to install; or whisper, when it's there).

transcribe.label: Transcribe recordings
transcribe.description: what was said is written under each recording, on this machine

auto.label: Transcribe at once
auto.description: off, a recording is transcribed only when asked (Transcribe audio)

engine.label: Transcriber
engine.description: automatic: Apple's on this machine when it has it (macOS 26), else whisper when it's installed

model.label: Whisper model
model.description: bigger is better and slower; left out, the best one already downloaded of small, base and tiny

language.label: Language
language.description: a language's code, like en or pt, to always transcribe in it; left out, Apple's uses the Mac's language and whisper detects it
